crossRefs.note: You will tread on the lion and cobra. You will trample the young lion and the serpent underfoot.
The nursing child will play near a cobra’s hole, and the weaned child will put his hand on the viper’s den.
You, son of man, don’t be afraid of them, neither be afraid of their words, though briers and thorns are with you, and…
they will take up serpents; and if they drink any deadly thing, it will in no way hurt them; they will lay hands on the…
However he shook off the creature into the fire, and wasn’t harmed.
And the God of peace will quickly crush Satan under your feet. The grace of our Lord Jesus Christ be with you.
You will be hated by all men for my name’s sake.
And not a hair of your head will perish.
What then shall we say about these things? If God is for us, who can be against us?
Be free from the love of money, content with such things as you have, for he has said, “I will in no way leave you…
So that with good courage we say, “The Lord is my helper. I will not fear. What can man do to me?”

translations.web: Behold, I give you authority to tread on serpents and scorpions, and over all the power of the enemy. Nothing will in any way hurt you.
translations.bsb: Behold, I have given you authority to tread on snakes and scorpions, and over all the power of the enemy. Nothing will harm you.
translations.kjv: Behold, I give unto you power to tread on serpents and scorpions, and over all the power of the enemy: and nothing shall by any means hurt you.
translations.asv: Behold, I have given you authority to tread upon serpents and scorpions, and over all the power of the enemy: and nothing shall in any wise hurt you.
